title: IN MEMORIAM: Dr Subhash C. Kashyap (1929 – 2026)
description: We condole the passing of Dr Subhash C. Kashyap, who served as the Honorary Research Professor at the Centre for Policy Research from 1990-2023. One of India’s foremost constitutional scholars, Dr Kashyap played a pivotal role in shaping public understanding of the Constitution, parliamentary institutions, and democratic governance.
